card.text: Tiny moon in Saturn's Keeler Gap that raises waves along the ring edges.

introduction.text: The Cassini team found Daphnis in 2005. Its waves in the A ring cast shadows at Saturn's equinox, when sunlight lines up with the rings.

normal.title: ISS mosaic
normal.summary: Green- and clear-filter Cassini images, brightness-matched. Its position extrapolates a 2005–2018 orbit fit.

filter-color.title: Cassini false color
filter-color.summary: Measured filter bands in false color, not human-visible color. Photographed shadows remain.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height above or below a 3.8 km sphere from the Cassini shape; small craters are not resolved.
